title: watcher-s1 event
description: One sideband event from watcher-s1, emitted as one JSON object per line. Schema 1. Consumers must ignore unknown fields; new optional fields may be added within schema 1, and a breaking change bumps `schema`. `heartbeat` and `stopped` were added to the `reason` enum within schema 1: heartbeats appear only when the caller opts in with --heartbeat, `stopped` only when a run is stopped through the (hidden) --control socket, but a consumer validating strictly against the older enum would reject them.

run_id.description: <host>:<watcher pid>:<start unix ms>. Exported to the child as WATCHER_S1_PARENT, so a nested watcher's `caused_by` names this run.

pgid.description: The child's process group (== pid: the child leads its own group).

state.description: progressing: output resumed after a stall (reason resumed), or, on a heartbeat, no stall or prompt episode is open. stalled: silence threshold or a blocked (D/U) process. waiting_on_input: an unanswered prompt. failing: non-zero exit, death by signal, timeout kill, or System One flags the output. done: exit 0 and nothing flags it.

reason.description: What triggered this event. stopped: the run was stopped through its control socket (the MCP watch_stop); a final event, with the job's real signal exit. heartbeat: a periodic status event (--heartbeat); state is then the current episode state and severity is always info.

exit.description: Set only on the final event. Exactly one of code/signal is non-null.

dedup_key.description: watcher-s1:<host>:<state>:<fnv1a64(cmd)>; stable across runs of the same command. Heartbeats use the literal segment `heartbeat` instead of the state, so all of a job's heartbeats share one key.

caused_by.description: The parent watcher's run_id (from WATCHER_S1_PARENT), or null.

evidence_tail.description: The last lines of output, ANSI stripped.

s1.description: System One verdict, or null when the tier is off, was not consulted, or failed open. `fused` is the question set's score (since the logistic set: sigmoid of the weighted answers); `failing`/`clean_done` are those two questions' raw answers.

probe.description: timeout: the probe itself hung (state unknown, maybe wedged).

proc.description: Optional. The latest process-state sample of the child's process group.

prompt.description: Optional. The prompt line, on waiting_on_input.

elapsed_ms.description: Optional, heartbeat only. Milliseconds since the watcher started the command (since attach in --log mode).

bytes_since_last.description: Optional, heartbeat only. Child output bytes since the previous heartbeat (or start).

lines_since_last.description: Optional, heartbeat only. Child output lines (newlines) since the previous heartbeat (or start).

last_line.description: Optional, heartbeat only. The last non-empty output line, ANSI stripped, truncated to 200 characters; null when there is none.

heartbeats_dropped.description: Optional, heartbeat only. How many heartbeats were dropped since the previous delivered one because the event sink was not keeping up (a full pipe or an unread --events-fd). Absent when none were.
